senses.gloss: m. (נָצַח) glory; use of the stem נָצַח for song.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite> (expl. <he>למנצח</he>) <he>למי שנִצּוּחוֹ נצח נצחים</he> to him whose glory is everlasting.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בני׳ וכ׳</he> with glorification (use of <he>נצח</he>) &c.; <cite ref="Pesachim 117a:12">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="N00616"><he>נִיגּוּן</he></cite>.
